propositions: A reconverge union merge aborts when tracked files with local working-tree changes (deletions or modifications) would be overwritten by merge from origin/tickets, leaving local commits orphaned and unable to advance
The recovery extends the existing variant (a) seam to detect 'Your local changes to the following files would be overwritten by merge' and parse affected paths from git output

Tracked file deletions (git status ' D' or 'D ') are restored non-destructively via git checkout, while tracked modifications are copied byte-for-byte to the reconverge-quarantine directory before restoration
After restoring or quarantining affected paths, the merge is retried once; any failure other than these specific local-changes cases falls back to abort-and-hint behavior
The fix prevents wedging of reconverge on interrupted fold operations that leave tracked EVENT-file deletions or `.archived` deletions, a recurring operational failure pattern
